title: Rust FragmentSender API bypasses authenticated SCHC version policy
description: Rule 7 and versioning correctness rereview: Rust AuthenticatedPeerSchcContext gates compression and mismatch Rule-255 size, but public FragmentSender::new accepts any compressed packet and has no peer/version capability. Production callers can fragment Rule 0 through 7 or Rule 255 for an unknown or mismatched peer, bypassing the DIO version requirement. Add an authenticated peer-bound fragmentation constructor or policy gate that requires current version 3 for all fragmented packets, while keeping a clearly internal/test raw constructor if needed. Add matching, mismatch, unknown, Rule 0, Rule 7, Rule 255, and stale evidence tests.
